end.summary:
Counted sides of triangles, rectangles, and squares.
Counted a shape’s sides from different starting points.
Discussed that a rectangle and square have four sides and four corners.
Triangle orientation and equal-side ideas remained mixed up; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised counting sides and corners of 2D shapes, including shapes turned in different positions. Ayaan used counting aloud and correctly counted several familiar shapes. They mixed up whether a tilted triangle is still a triangle and how many corners a shape has; this was not corrected by the end. At home, turn paper triangles and ask Ayaan to trace each side and corner while counting.
